# Decision: ADR-0058. The sdk is the surface a component author builds on,
# and serve.Tool is the entry point of a tool component. Its callers are the
# tool components that `gibson component new` generates from the adk template
# gibson/cmd/gibson/internal/scaffold/templates/tool/main.go.tmpl:72. A
# generated component lives outside every first-party repo, so no scan can
# load it as a consumer. Delete this entry only with the template call.
